title: CodeAssay: A Multi-Metric Benchmark with Audited Ground Truth for LLM Code Generation
description: CodeAssay is a taxonomy-first Python benchmark of 185 tasks in 10 categories informed by SWEBOK v4 knowledge areas and BigCodeBench domains. Each task ships a reference solution and a pytest suite split into public tests (shown to the model) and hidden tests (used only for grading). Every task passed an independent audit-and-fix. Correctness is graded on the hidden tests; quality indicators for cyclomatic complexity, style and security are reported for passing solutions. Mutation testing validates the benchmark test suites rather than scoring models. No composite score is reported.
